title: Nikon Z 5 II All-Rounder Full-Frame
purpose: A fantastic all-rounder for a variety of photographers, pairing 24MP full-frame CMOS image quality with 4K 60p video, a fully-articulating touchscreen, and great value.

sensor_and_optics.lens: NIKKOR Z 24-70mm f/4 S (11/14 elements, 7 rounded blades)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 14.5 stops dynamic range with 14-bit NEF RAW and 4K 60p video recording
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Focal-plane mechanical and electronic front-curtain shutter with 1/200s flash sync

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Natural daylight balanced with subtle off-axis flash fill, 1/200s sync, ISO 100
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Soft directional key light 35 to 45 degrees off-axis, gentle wrap fill preserving delicate skin highlight roll-off, clean environmental separation

surface_rendering: Natural epidermal skin texture with authentic pore definition, fine vellus hair, and true-to-life Nikon color science
True material micro-relief: fabric weave, leather grain, and gradual highlight roll-off with generous dynamic range
Pristine optical acutance from NIKKOR Z optics without digital edge halos or unsharp masking artifacts
Clean documentary clarity without artificial smoothing, no diffusion, no haze
depth_and_optics: Critical focal lock on near eye with eyelashes and iris tack sharp, zero motion blur
Smooth, progressive focus roll-off characteristic of high-grade NIKKOR Z glass at f/4-f/5.6
Clean rectilinear projection and distortion-free perspective geometry

execution_directive: Enforce versatile 24MP full-frame CMOS raw capture with authentic Nikon color science, balanced highlight/shadow roll-off, and pristine optical acutance.
